title: Generosity & Legacy
intro: A baby can give nothing back, which makes this the purest month of the year. Everything is one-directional, and that is the shape of the love being taught. This month is about what is being handed down — a faith, a family, a way of holding an open hand.

keyScriptures.text: We will tell the next generation the praiseworthy deeds of the Lord.
It is more blessed to give than to receive.

weeks.title: Everything Given, Nothing Owed
weeks.declaration: You are given everything and you owe nothing. That is what love looks like before anyone can repay it.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, let us give this year without keeping account. Amen.

weeks.title: A Faith Handed Down
weeks.declaration: You are being handed a faith older than any of us. It is not ours to invent, only to pass on.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, let the faith in this house be real enough to be worth inheriting. Amen.

weeks.title: An Open Hand
weeks.declaration: You will learn whether hands in this family are open or closed. We intend them to be open.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, make us generous while our child is watching. Let open-handedness be normal here. Amen.

weeks.title: What We Leave You
weeks.declaration: What we leave you will mostly not be things. It will be how we treated people, and whether our hands were open or closed.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, help us build something worth inheriting out of ordinary days. Amen.

days.title: Given Everything
days.declaration: You are given everything and asked for nothing. That is how love starts.

scripture.text: This is love: not that we loved God, but that he loved us.

days.title: Nothing Owed
days.declaration: You owe nobody for being here. Not us, not anyone.

scripture.text: You did not receive a spirit that makes you a slave again to fear.

days.title: A Faith Handed Down
days.declaration: You are being handed something older than all of us. It was never ours to invent.

scripture.text: Your sincere faith, which first lived in your grandmother.

days.title: Told the Story
days.declaration: We will tell you the story until you know it, and then you will tell someone else.

scripture.text: We will tell the next generation.

days.title: An Open Hand
days.declaration: You will learn whether hands here are open or closed. We mean them to be open.

scripture.text: A generous person will prosper.

days.title: Given Before You Could Ask
days.declaration: Most of what you have was given before you knew to want it. That is grace.

scripture.text: It is by grace you have been saved.

days.title: Someone Prayed for You
days.declaration: People prayed for you before you existed. You are already in a chain.

scripture.text: Cities you did not build, vineyards you did not plant.

days.title: Room Made
days.declaration: Room was made for you without being taken from anyone. There was enough.

scripture.text: My Father's house has many rooms.

days.title: Time Is the Gift
days.declaration: The best thing given to you this year is time, and it cannot be bought.

scripture.text: Making the most of every opportunity.

days.title: Given Gladly
days.declaration: Nothing here is given grudgingly. You will learn the difference in tone before the words.

scripture.text: God loves a cheerful giver.

days.title: What We Will Leave
days.declaration: What we leave you will mostly not be things. It will be how we treated people.

scripture.text: A good name is more desirable than great riches.

days.title: Passing On Kindness
days.declaration: Kindness done to you now will travel out of you later. That is how it works.

scripture.text: Freely you have received; freely give.

days.title: A Family Beyond Us
days.declaration: You have people who will love you that we have not met yet. Family keeps growing.

scripture.text: Whoever does God's will is my brother and sister.

days.title: Enough to Share
days.declaration: There is enough here. That is the first thing to know before learning to share.

scripture.text: My God will meet all your needs.

days.title: Looked After Well
days.declaration: Looking after what you are given is part of generosity. It keeps it useful for the next person.

scripture.text: If you have not been trustworthy in handling worldly wealth...

days.title: Sowing Without Seeing
days.declaration: Most of what we do for you now we will never see the result of. We do it anyway.

scripture.text: A man reaps what he sows.

days.title: Not Kept, Raised
days.declaration: You are not being kept. You are being raised, which means being prepared to leave.

scripture.text: Children are like arrows in the hands of a warrior.

days.title: Hospitality Learned Early
days.declaration: May you grow up in a house where people come in. May a full table seem normal.

scripture.text: Practise hospitality.

days.title: Forgiveness Given Freely
days.declaration: Forgiveness will be given to you before you can ask for it. That is the most generous thing there is.

scripture.text: Forgive as the Lord forgave you.

days.title: Named in Our Prayers
days.declaration: You are named in our prayers daily. That is an inheritance you cannot spend.

scripture.text: I thank my God every time I remember you.

days.title: Generous with Words
days.declaration: May you grow up hearing encouragement given away freely. It costs nothing and lasts decades.

scripture.text: Only what is helpful for building others up.

days.title: Small and Real
days.declaration: Generosity here will mostly be small and real rather than large and rare.

scripture.text: This poor widow has put more in than all the others.

days.title: Handed the Good Bits
days.declaration: We will hand you the best of what we have rather than the leftovers.

scripture.text: Honour the Lord with the firstfruits of all your crops.

days.title: Not for Show
days.declaration: Nothing given to you is for anyone else's benefit or admiration.

scripture.text: Do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing.

days.title: Grateful Givers
days.declaration: May you learn that giving makes people glad. You will see it in us before you feel it.

scripture.text: It is more blessed to give than to receive.

days.title: Justice as Generosity
days.declaration: Some giving is standing up for someone. May you learn that kind too.

scripture.text: Act justly, love mercy.

days.title: Beyond This Family
days.declaration: May your generosity reach further than the people who can return it.

scripture.text: Invite the poor... and you will be blessed.

days.title: A Long Chain
days.declaration: You are in the middle of a chain, not at the start. Others gave before us.

scripture.text: His faithfulness continues through all generations.

days.title: Starting Now
days.declaration: What you will be remembered for has already started, in a year you will not recall.

scripture.text: Cast your bread upon the waters.

days.title: Built to Outlast
days.declaration: We are trying to build something that works when we are not in the room.

scripture.text: Their work will be shown for what it is.

days.title: Yours to Give Away
days.declaration: Everything given to you this year is meant to leave you again one day. That is not a loss.

scripture.text: You will abound in every good work.
